tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: A boy of mass $20 \mathrm{~kg}$ is standing on a $80 \mathrm{~kg}$ free to move long cart. There is negligible friction between cart and ground. Initially, the boy is standing $25 \mathrm{~m}$ from a wall. If he walks $10 \mathrm{~m}$ on the cart towards the wall, then the final distance of the boy from the wall will be
